definitions.explanation: Something that changes every day, most commonly used for daily lunch specials or rotating menus at restaurants.

examples.japanese: {日替|ひが}わりランチを{頼|たの}んだ。
examples.english: I ordered the daily lunch special.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{日替|ひが}わりは{何|なん}ですか？
この{定食屋|ていしょくや}は{日替|ひが}わりメニューが{豊富|ほうふ}で{飽|あ}きない。
examples.english: This set-meal restaurant has a variety of daily specials, so I never get bored.

notes:
{日替|ひが}わり is most commonly seen in restaurant contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日替|ひが}わりランチ (daily lunch special)
- {日替|ひが}わりメニュー (daily changing menu)
- {日替|ひが}わり{定食|ていしょく} (daily set meal)
- {日替|ひが}わり{弁当|べんとう} (daily bento)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {週替|しゅうが}わり: weekly special
- {本日|ほんじつ}の: today's (special)
- おすすめ: recommendation

KANJI NOTE:
- Can also be written as {日替り|ひがわり} with okurigana.
